description: Presentation + operations layer: update container/build_diagram.py to show the TWO environments distinctly (test=rolling, prod=CodeDeploy blue/green) with the CodeDeploy icon and 'Coffee Shop' labels and regenerate container/architecture.svg + top-level architecture.svg/architecture.png; create demo/session4-coffee-ship/demo-pipeline.sh + DEMO-SCRIPT.md; update README.md, FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md, deploy.sh, destroy.sh. Resolves MEDIUM finding 2 (both CloudFront URLs resolved + printed; TestCloudFrontUrl output). Depends on FEAT-003 for the real output names/resources (TestCloudFrontUrl, coffee-ship-prod CodeDeploy app, two clusters).
steps: container/build_diagram.py: add ICONS['codedeploy'] = 'Arch_Developer-Tools/64/Arch_AWS-CodeDeploy_64.svg'. Redraw the runtime lane as two paths: User -> CloudFront(prod) -> prod ALB (two target groups blue/green) -> prod ECS service (CODE_DEPLOY); and User -> CloudFront(test) -> test ALB -> test ECS service (rolling). Redraw the CI/CD deploy edges as two actions: EcsDeployAction (rolling) -> test service, and CodeDeployEcsDeployAction (blue/green canary 10%/5m) -> prod service, with the Approval gate between them. Relabel nodes 'Coffee Shop'. Keep the base64-embedded *_64.svg approach and the AWS category color zones.
Regenerate: `cd container && python3 build_diagram.py`; then `cp container/architecture.svg architecture.svg` (top-level) and `rsvg-convert container/architecture.svg -o architecture.png`.

Create demo/session4-coffee-ship/demo-pipeline.sh: `#!/usr/bin/env bash`, `set -euo pipefail`, export AWS_REGION/AWS_DEFAULT_REGION=ap-southeast-1. Step-by-step narration with `read -p` pauses. Resolve SOURCE_BUCKET (StackResources AWS::S3::Bucket | [0] from CoffeeShipAppPipeline), CLOUDFRONT_URL (Outputs OutputKey=='CloudFrontUrl'), and TEST_CLOUDFRONT_URL via `aws cloudformation describe-stacks --stack-name CoffeeShipAppPipeline --query "Stacks[0].Outputs[?OutputKey=='TestCloudFrontUrl'].OutputValue | [0]" --output text`. Steps: curl prod URL (shows Coffee Shop); live `sed -i` edit of APP_NAME in container/frontend/src/App.jsx and the <title> in container/frontend/index.html from Coffee Shop -> BeanThere Cafe, show the diff; zip container/ (exclude *.pyc, __pycache__, */node_modules/*, */dist/*) to source.zip and `aws s3 cp` to the bucket (ONE run); poll `aws codepipeline get-pipeline-state --name coffee-ship` until Approval; verify TEST via TEST_CLOUDFRONT_URL shows 'BeanThere Cafe' while prod still shows 'Coffee Shop'; approve with `aws codepipeline put-approval-result --pipeline-name coffee-ship --stage-name Approval --action-name Manual_Approval --result summary=approved,status=Approved --token <TOKEN>`; watch blue/green with `aws deploy list-deployments --application-name coffee-ship-prod` and `aws deploy get-deployment --deployment-id <id>` (canary shift); curl prod to show 'BeanThere Cafe'; print rollback instructions (CodeDeploy auto-rollback on failure/alarm).

Create DEMO-SCRIPT.md: mirror the demo-pipeline.sh steps as copy-pasteable numbered commands, including both CloudFront URL resolutions and the Coffee Shop -> BeanThere Cafe edit, and the headline test-vs-prod difference.

deploy.sh: add TEST_CLOUDFRONT_URL resolution (same describe-stacks query, OutputKey=='TestCloudFrontUrl') and a summary print line mirroring the existing ' CloudFront URL : ' line (e.g. ' Test CloudFront : '). Leave the existing AWS::S3::Bucket | [0] source-bucket lookup intact (CloudFront adds no S3 bucket, so [0] is unaffected).

destroy.sh: add a note (comment or echo) that the second CloudFront distribution and the CodeDeploy application/deployment group are removed by `cdk destroy --all` in-stack; no new manual deletion needed beyond emptying buckets/ECR.

README.md + FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md: app is 'Coffee Shop'; describe two envs (coffee-ship-test = rolling EcsDeployAction vs coffee-ship-prod = CodeDeploy blue/green canary 10%/5min + alarm rollback); state plainly that blue/green IS NOW demonstrated; update the two-service + CodeDeploy bootstrap/first-run order with the :latest seed; replace single-cluster `aws ecs describe-services --cluster coffee-ship --services coffee-ship` with the coffee-ship-test and coffee-ship-prod equivalents; mention TestCloudFrontUrl as the test entry point and CloudFrontUrl as prod.
acceptance_criteria: `cd container && python3 build_diagram.py` runs without error; container/architecture.svg contains >=12 'data:image/svg+xml;base64' embedded icons including a CodeDeploy icon; top-level architecture.svg matches and architecture.png is regenerated and non-empty.
demo-pipeline.sh and deploy.sh each reference BOTH TestCloudFrontUrl and the prod CloudFrontUrl; demo-pipeline.sh uses put-approval-result with --pipeline-name and uses aws deploy get-deployment.
README.md and FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md state blue/green is demonstrated and describe the two environments distinctly.
verification: cp container/architecture.svg architecture.svg && rsvg-convert container/architecture.svg -o architecture.png && test -s architecture.png && echo png-ok
bash -n demo-pipeline.sh && bash -n deploy.sh && bash -n destroy.sh && echo bash-syntax-ok
findings: DONE. (1) container/build_diagram.py rewritten: added ICONS['codedeploy']=Arch_Developer-Tools/64/Arch_AWS-CodeDeploy_64.svg; redrew the runtime as TWO distinct env zones (green TEST = CloudFront TestCloudFrontUrl -> test ALB -> coffee-ship-test ECS, rolling; orange PROD = CloudFront CloudFrontUrl -> prod ALB blue/green TGs -> coffee-ship-prod ECS, CODE_DEPLOY); CI/CD lane now shows EcsDeployAction (rolling) -> TEST and, after the Approval gate, CodeDeployEcsDeployAction (blue/green canary 10%/5m) -> PROD via the CodeDeploy node; all nodes/title say 'Coffee Shop'; base64 *_64.svg embedding + AWS category color zones kept. (2) Regenerated container/architecture.svg (14 embedded 'data:image/svg+xml;base64' icons incl. CodeDeploy, >=12), copied to top-level architecture.svg, re-rendered architecture.png via /opt/homebrew/bin/rsvg-convert (non-empty). (3) Created demo-pipeline.sh (bash set -euo pipefail, region ap-southeast-1, read -p pauses; resolves SOURCE_BUCKET [0], CloudFrontUrl, TestCloudFrontUrl; live sed edit Coffee Shop->BeanThere Cafe in App.jsx + index.html with GNU/BSD sed detection; zip+upload ONE source.zip excluding pyc/__pycache__/node_modules/dist; polls get-pipeline-state to Approval capturing the token; verifies TEST shows BeanThere Cafe while PROD still shows Coffee Shop; put-approval-result --pipeline-name coffee-ship --stage-name Approval --action-name Manual_Approval; watches blue/green via aws deploy list-deployments + aws deploy get-deployment; curls prod; rollback notes incl. stop-deployment + auto-rollback on failure/alarm + git checkout). (4) Created DEMO-SCRIPT.md mirroring all steps as copy-pasteable numbered commands incl. both URL resolutions and the rename, headline TEST-vs-PROD difference. (5) deploy.sh: added TEST_CLOUDFRONT_URL resolution (OutputKey TestCloudFrontUrl) + ' Test CloudFront :' summary line mirroring the prod ' CloudFront URL :' line; kept the AWS::S3::Bucket | [0] source-bucket lookup; updated closing narration to two-env rolling+blue/green. (6) destroy.sh: added note that the second CloudFront distribution + coffee-ship-prod CodeDeploy app/deployment group are in-stack and removed by cdk destroy --all. (7) README.md + FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md: app is 'Coffee Shop'; two envs described distinctly (coffee-ship-test rolling EcsDeployAction vs coffee-ship-prod CodeDeploy blue/green canary 10%/5min + alarm rollback); state plainly blue/green IS NOW demonstrated; two-service + CodeDeploy bootstrap/first-run order with :latest seed; replaced single-cluster describe-services with coffee-ship-test and coffee-ship-prod equivalents; TestCloudFrontUrl = test entry, CloudFrontUrl = prod. VERIFICATION ALL PASS: python3 build_diagram.py OK; grep -c embedded icons = 14; grep -ci codedeploy build_diagram.py = 10; png regen png-ok (non-empty); bash -n demo-pipeline.sh/deploy.sh/destroy.sh = bash-syntax-ok; TestCloudFrontUrl present in demo-pipeline.sh + deploy.sh; CloudFrontUrl present in both; aws deploy get-deployment present in demo-pipeline.sh; blue/green stated in README.md + FACILITATOR-RUNBOOK.md. NOTE on the put-approval-result verification grep: the command uses --pipeline-name coffee-ship but spans multiple lines (standard shell line-continuation), so the literal single-line 'grep put-approval-result | grep --pipeline-name' returns nothing; confirmed correct via 'grep -A1 put-approval-result | grep -- --pipeline-name' = approval-ok. app/** untouched; internal resource names remain coffee-ship*; only the user-facing name is Coffee Shop.
